items: Make your own witch: before your first flight she stands in her treehouse and you dress her up: hat (shape, height, lean, brim), hair, top and cloak, broom, accessories and the colour of every part, with Randomise and Classic buttons
She's remembered on this browser for next time; 👗 Change her look on the start screen opens it again
Every look keeps her a witch: always a pointed hat with its glowing band, and a broom
